title: Compute discriminant projection directions
description: You solve for directions from the class scatter matrices and project both splits.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You compute scatter matrices and add reg to Sw's diagonal. The active code solves Sw_reg against Sb and calls np.linalg.eig on the resulting matrix.
You sort eigenvalues by descending real part. The same ordering selects the corresponding eigenvector columns.

steps.question: How many projection directions does the function retain for C classes?
steps.answer: It retains C-1 columns and their eigenvalues. The recorded call returns two directions.

steps.description: You use the same W to project training and test features. The recorded eigenvalues are 30.47025 and 0.43653, and the output reports the training projection's shape.
